about: The decision graph of the storm (WS-214), kept by incident.researcher@web-summit.dinis. Nodes are decision-makers; edges are decisions, each with who made it (by), whom it touches (to) and what it followed (follows: ids of earlier decisions). Every node and edge carries a label (fact, evidence or hypothesis), its source URL and the UTC time it was read, and who read it. Read the README first.

labels.fact: read by us or a named desk on the primary source (the decision-maker's own channel)
labels.evidence: reported by a secondary source (press, a person's account of a statement) or a primary page we could not read; true until a primary source says otherwise
labels.hypothesis: our reasoning; carries reasons (and against); never stated as fact

status_values.not_announced: due but nothing announced at the time read
status_values.expected: a hypothesis about a decision to come
status_values.unknown: cannot tell: the source is unreadable or not yet read

nodes.name: IPMA (Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera)
nodes.role: Issues weather warnings by district and type (green to red) and special communiqués.
nodes.label: fact

nodes.name: ANEPC (Autoridade Nacional de Emergência e Proteção Civil)
nodes.role: Special alerts to the civil-protection system (responders) and warnings to the public (written avisos, SMS).
nodes.label: fact

nodes.name: Government of Portugal (Council of Ministers)
nodes.role: Declares alert, contingency or calamity under the civil-protection framework law (Lei 27/2006) and sets exceptional measures.
nodes.label: fact

nodes.name: Ministry of Internal Administration (MAI)
nodes.role: Leads the alert declaration; named by Lisbon's mayor as deciding on Web Summit together with the organisers.
nodes.label: evidence

nodes.name: Prime Minister
nodes.role: Spoke for the government on the recommendation to suspend Web Summit.
nodes.label: evidence

nodes.name: Câmara Municipal de Lisboa (mayor, municipal civil protection)
nodes.role: Municipal civil-protection service and commission; decides on the municipal emergency plan, gardens, municipal services; announces city transport status.
nodes.label: evidence
nodes.blocked: lisboa.pt and informacao.lisboa.pt: 403 to automated reads (18:58Z, 18:59Z)

nodes.name: Schools (Ministry of Education)
nodes.role: Closed by measure (a) of the alert declaration, co-signed by the Minister of Education.
nodes.label: fact

nodes.name: Metropolitano de Lisboa
nodes.role: Runs Lisbon's metro (serves the venue at Oriente).
nodes.label: evidence

nodes.name: Carris
nodes.role: Lisbon buses and trams.
nodes.label: fact

nodes.name: CP (Comboios de Portugal) and Infraestruturas de Portugal
nodes.role: Trains (Oriente station serves the venue).
nodes.label: fact
nodes.blocked: cp.pt is a JavaScript app: 3 KB shell, no notices in HTML

nodes.name: Lusoponte (25 de Abril and Vasco da Gama bridges)
nodes.role: Sets bridge traffic restrictions.
nodes.label: evidence

nodes.name: Lisbon road tunnels (city)
nodes.role: Tunnels closed from midnight by the city.
nodes.label: evidence

nodes.name: Transtejo Soflusa (Tagus ferries)
nodes.role: River crossings.
nodes.label: evidence

nodes.name: Rede Expressos (intercity coaches)
nodes.role: Intercity coach network.
nodes.label: evidence

nodes.name: Lisbon airport (ANA, Humberto Delgado) and airlines
nodes.role: Flight operations; each airline decides its own cancellations.
nodes.label: fact
nodes.blocked: aeroportolisboa.pt returns a 212-byte page (bot check); lisbon-airport.com is not the official site

nodes.name: Autoridade Marítima Nacional and the Port of Lisbon
nodes.role: Sea warnings; harbour masters close or restrict the bar.
nodes.label: evidence

nodes.name: Venue operators: MEO Arena and FIL
nodes.role: Run the halls; their own safety decisions.
nodes.label: fact

nodes.name: Web Summit (the organisers)
nodes.role: Decides whether Wednesday's programme runs, changes or is suspended.
nodes.label: fact

nodes.name: Side events on Wednesday (e.g. Dear Gatekeepers Live, MEO Arena studio; Night Summit)
nodes.role: Each organiser decides its own event.
nodes.label: evidence

nodes.name: Fertagus (trains across the 25 de Abril bridge)
nodes.role: Train service Setúbal–Lisbon.
nodes.label: evidence

nodes.name: Carris Metropolitana
nodes.role: Metropolitan-area buses.
nodes.label: evidence

nodes.name: FlixBus
nodes.role: Intercity coaches.
nodes.label: evidence

edges.decision: Names the low CHARLES (communiqué no. 1); orange warnings to follow, upgrade not ruled out
edges.label: fact

edges.decision: Public warning Aviso 21: gusts to 120 km/h, avoid unnecessary travel
edges.label: fact

edges.decision: Raises special readiness of the civil-protection system; SMS to the population about Wednesday
edges.label: fact
edges.note: Colour of the readiness level not stated on the pages read.

edges.decision: Alert situation for all of mainland Portugal, 11 Nov 00:00 to 23:59: (a) schools and non-essential public services close; (b) outdoor events suspended, whatever their nature; (c) no access to high-risk parks; (d) temporary structures secured; (e) no access to shoreline and flood areas; activates coordination centres and civil-protection commissions
edges.label: fact
edges.note: Declared before the red warnings were issued (red wind first read 14:23Z). Page dated 12:10 (Lisbon = UTC in November).

edges.decision: Schools closed on Wednesday
edges.label: fact

edges.decision: Red wind warning, Lisbon district, 11 Nov 12:00 to 21:00 (gusts to 120, up to 140 km/h)
edges.label: fact
edges.note: "at" is the first time the newsroom read it, not IPMA's issue time (the JSON carries no issue time).

edges.decision: Rain raised to red, Lisbon district, 11 Nov 12:00 to 18:00 (orange 05:00 to 12:00); sea orange 12:00 to 21:00
edges.label: fact

edges.decision: Communiqué no. 2: rain, wind and sea agitation, Depressão CHARLES, mainland and Madeira
edges.label: fact

edges.decision: Organisers: aware of the warnings, assessing with ANEPC and PSP, update to follow; no sign yet of cancelling Wednesday
edges.label: evidence
edges.note: Press report of an organiser statement; not found on websummit.com.

edges.decision: Mayor: "Tudo indica que a Web Summit não poderá funcionar amanhã"; the decision is the Interior Ministry's and the organisers'
edges.label: evidence

edges.decision: Lisbon road tunnels closed from midnight
edges.label: evidence

edges.decision: 25 de Abril and Vasco da Gama bridges limited to 60 km/h
edges.label: evidence

edges.decision: Metro to run on Wednesday (announced by the mayor)
edges.label: evidence
edges.note: Said by the mayor, not read on metrolisboa.pt (no notice found in its HTML at 18:58Z).

edges.decision: Carris to run, buses followed "minute by minute" from the operations centre (mayor); carris.pt banner "Alerta: perturbações na circulação"
edges.label: fact

edges.decision: Coach services suspended Wednesday 10:00 to midnight
edges.label: evidence
edges.note: From a search summary of press reports; the article itself not yet opened. Treat as a lead.

edges.decision: Government recommends suspending Web Summit on Wednesday; the decision rests with the organisers ("Já emitimos a nossa recomendação de que os trabalhos desse evento possam suspender-se")
edges.label: evidence

edges.decision: Wednesday 11 Nov: run, change or suspend
edges.label: fact
edges.note: 19:32Z: nothing on websummit.com (home, sitemap: no new URL since 18:58Z), nothing on Bluesky websummit.bsky.social (last post 17:36Z), Jornal de Negócios live (last entries 18:25) and a web search show no organiser decision.

edges.decision: HYPOTHESIS: the organisers suspend or shorten Wednesday
edges.label: hypothesis
reasons: The government recommended it (17:53Z) and the mayor expected it (13:19Z).
Outdoor events are suspended by the alert; red wind from 12:00 overlaps the whole programme day.
Tuesday: water in a pavilion (17:07Z) and a thin audience (15:19Z).
against: The halls are indoors; measure (b) names outdoor events only.

edges.decision: HYPOTHESIS: side events at the venue follow the organisers' decision; outdoor ones are suspended by measure (b)
edges.label: hypothesis
reasons: Measure (b) covers outdoor events whatever their nature.

edges.decision: Municipal emergency plan activation and the city's own measures ("Situação de Alerta: medidas excecionais em Lisboa")
edges.label: evidence
edges.note: Page title seen in search by weather@; site refuses automated reads (403). A person must read it.

edges.decision: Flight operations on Wednesday
edges.label: fact
edges.note: No readable notice: the official site returns a bot check. Superseded by ana-conditioned (press, 18:04Z).

edges.decision: Train service on Wednesday
edges.label: fact

edges.decision: Possible disruption on Wednesday announced by Fertagus, Carris and Carris Metropolitana; no suspension announced (as of 16:59Z)
edges.label: evidence

edges.decision: ANA: operations at Lisbon, Faro and Madeira airports conditioned on 11 Nov; cancellations expected
edges.label: evidence
edges.note: Press report of an ANA statement; the official airport site is behind a bot check.

edges.decision: FlixBus suspends all national links in Portugal on Wednesday 11 Nov
edges.label: evidence
